RustyShelf 0.5.0 is the first stable release of the native app: the Rust and Bevy rewrite of RustyShelf, for Windows, Linux and Android. It replaces the Electron app as RustyShelf. The Electron app, with its Capacitor Android app, stays on the [`archive/electron`](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/tree/archive/electron) branch, and the two read and write the same settings and data, so a setup made in either works in both.

## What it is

Your game library as a shelf you browse from the couch: emulated console games, Steam and other PC games stand side by side as real boxes, in each console's own case, played with one controller.

- **The shelf.** Every game in its console's case, front, spine and back, under the eighteen colour themes, the newer still themes and your own. Home, favourites, sort and filter, Find a game, Surprise me, and Inspect to turn a case over in your hands.
- **Console games through your emulators**, started as the Electron app starts them: RetroArch and the standalone emulators, Set up for me on Windows, the quit combo and the Home menu over a running game, for Xbox, Nintendo and PlayStation pads and the Wii remote.
- **PC games on the same shelf:** Steam, Epic Games, GOG Galaxy, Ubisoft Connect, the EA app, Xbox / Game Pass, HoYoPlay, a PC games folder, Quiver's apps, Ports & Recomps and programs you add yourself; on Linux, Epic and Windows games through Wine / Proton.
- **Box art and manuals found for you**, with the Art Studio and Manual Studio to choose between versions, ScreenScraper, SteamGridDB, LaunchBox and IGDB, more screenshots, and Wii U e-manuals made from the games' own files.
- **Extras:** RetroAchievements, Steam, Xbox 360 and PS3 achievements, the phone companion as a remote, Kid mode, RomM, menu music and sounds (your own too), attract mode, Discord, export and import, and English, French, Turkish and Brazilian Portuguese.

## New since alpha 6

- **Game streaming.** With a host PC paired in Moonlight (Sunshine or GeForce Experience), its games stand on a Game streaming shelf and Play opens them in Moonlight fullscreen; a host with a MAC address is woken over Wake-on-LAN first. Settings → Game streaming. From Zak's fork of Boxshelf.
- **Covers for Steam, store and added games.** Details → Box art opens a grid of covers: Steam's own, SteamGridDB's posters, a search under another name, a picture of yours, or back to automatic.
- **Console boxes for PC games.** A PC game can wear the box of its console release (PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PS4, Xbox One, Switch), with its back and a PC band on the spine. The PC games gallery shows every PC game's cover and where it comes from, and Settings → Custom games → Covers goes through the custom games without one.
- **Backs of the box for PC games:** a picture of yours, or LaunchBox's.
- **Recomps in their console's case.** A program put on a console's shelf gets that console's whole case, the Art Studio and manuals, and stays a PC game with its play time. Put recomps on their console's shelf can place them by itself (off by default).
- **The Art Studio:** Lock this game keeps every part as it is, Back to the shelf style undoes a pick, and a part's versions can be filtered by region, source, type and edition.
- **Art match** for a ROM hack, translation or mod: look the game's art up under the original's name.
- **The Sort panel and the quick menu**, as in the Electron app: G opens the Sort panel, and a Menu tap or Tab opens the quick menu at the right.
- **Look and controls:** Interface size, Open into (the last shelf and game, or Home), Reduce motion, Scroll speed, Controller rumble and the consoles' order.
- **Motion:** Settings, Details and the shelf menu glide and fade as in the Electron app.
- **Pastel Pop**, a bright pastel theme with glossy bubbles.
- **French:** Zak's French merged into ours, with French and Turkish for the new pages.

### Fixed

- Less stutter on the shelf and in Settings: covers land a few at a time, settings are written off the frame, and sorting, filtering and art loading run on worker threads.
- Newer themes and voices stay chosen after a restart instead of going back to Spectrum and Aero.
- The shelf menu's Settings opens Settings with its tabs.

## Download

| | File | |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `RustyShelf-0.5.0-windows.exe` | No installer: put it in your RustyShelf folder to keep the setup you have, and run it. `--windowed` starts it in a window. |
| **Linux** | `RustyShelf-0.5.0-linux.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it once, then start it. |
| **Android** | `RustyShelf-0.5.0-android.apk` | arm64. Open it on the device and allow the install. It installs beside the Electron branch's Android app. From this release on, each APK is signed with RustyShelf's own key and installs over the one before; an alpha's APK has to be uninstalled once first. |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has each file's SHA-256 sum.

It uses the Electron app's folder: beside the program when a `data` folder is there, else `~/RustyShelf`. With no setup there it sets itself up on the first run. A new version copies your setup before it starts, and Settings → System → Undo the update's settings changes puts it back.

## Not there yet

- The Manual Studio's Repair, and opening the case in Inspect (its disc and its manual inside).
- The rest of the Art Studio (backs and spines RustyShelf draws itself) and of Seamless play (the loading cover, the window mode, Go to desktop).
- Android is at its first stage: choosing the emulator app, play time, box art and the Thor's bottom screen are still to come.
- The museum stays in the Electron app.

The manual lists [everything that works](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/docs/MANUAL.md#what-works). Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues).
